label: Early foundations → adult life + shelf filler
scope: Complete draft coverage of the recorded core adult and essential occupational requirements; not proof of developmental sufficiency, adult independence, employment eligibility or a qualification.
semantics: Every listed input is required (AND). Gates aggregate evidence and cannot be ticked complete. Existing completion records count only when their pilot inputs are also complete. The two endpoints are parallel goals; independent living is not an employment prerequisite.
access: Use speech, sign, AAC, accessible text, assistive tools and agreed human support. Adapt the activity and record the assistance used. There is no fixed age or duration; early tasks are supporter-mediated, and adult/work scenarios are for an appropriate later context.
review_needed: Development and accessibility review of early and intermediate steps
Adult-life practitioner review of scenario coverage
Retail practitioner review, local procedures and supervised workplace assessment

stages.label: 1. Supported early foundations
stages.description: No prior learning records required. A familiar supporter offers play, communication access, choices and co-regulation. These are possible entry points, not an age test.

stages.label: 2. Shared practical foundations
stages.description: Develop communication, reading, quantities, safe action and planning through repeated supported practice. Different access methods and help remain valid.

stages.label: 3. Everyday adult life
stages.description: All 14 core requirements of the Atlas Independent adult role. Each branch retains its existing draft activities and adds a concrete demonstration.

stages.label: 4. Shelf-filling practice
stages.description: All eight essential skills in ESCO 1.2.1 for shelf filler, with contextual demonstrations. Optional ESCO skills and employer-specific induction remain outside this pilot.
